import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { BlogCarouselService } from './BlogCarouselService'; import { BlogItem } from "src/app/entitys/blog-carousel/BlogItem"; @Component({ selector: 'app-blog-carousel', templateUrl: './blog-carousel.component.html', styleUrls: ['./blog-carousel.component.css'] }) export class BlogCarouselComponent implements OnInit { currentIndex : number = 0; isAddModalOpen : boolean = false; constructor(private blogCarouselService: BlogCarouselService) {} items: BlogItem[] = []; ngOnInit(): void { this.loadBlogs(); } get visibleItems(): BlogItem[] { const duplicated = [...this.items, ...this.items]; return duplicated.slice(this.currentIndex, this.currentIndex + 3); } private loadBlogs(): void { this.blogCarouselService.getBlogs().subscribe({ next: (blogs : BlogItem[]) => { this.items = blogs; }, error: () => { this.items = []; } }); } next(): void { this.currentIndex++; if (this.currentIndex >= this.items.length) { this.currentIndex = 0; } } prev(): void { this.currentIndex--; if (this.currentIndex < 0) { this.currentIndex = this.items.length - 1; } } openAddModal(): void { this.isAddModalOpen = true; } closeAddModal(): void { this.isAddModalOpen = false; } }
